FAQ

Questions, answered.

Is Makzora Business OS already live?+

Makzora Business OS is currently accepting a limited number of founding businesses for customised early access. Each setup is delivered in phases based on the client's highest-priority workflows.

Can the system be trained on my business?+

Yes. The AI can be configured using your approved services, pricing, FAQs, policies and company information.

Will my team be able to take over conversations?+

Yes. Human handover is an essential part of the platform, allowing your team to step into important conversations when needed.

Do I have to replace all my current tools?+

No. We can begin with one high-value workflow, integrate with suitable existing systems and expand gradually.

Does WhatsApp integration cost extra?+

WhatsApp and other third-party platforms may charge usage fees. These costs depend on message volume and provider pricing.

Can Business OS work for different industries?+

Yes. The platform is designed to be customised for different service-based businesses, processes and customer journeys.

Will my company's data be separated from other businesses?+

Yes. Each business account must have secure, separated access to its own data, users, knowledge and workflows.

What happens after I apply?+

Our team reviews your business requirements, arranges a discovery call and recommends the best first workflow to automate.
